verdict.rationale: The desktop app runs locally on your machine and can be built and run from source in the public repo (`pnpm --filter @omnirush/desktop dev`). You can also plug in your own OpenAI/Anthropic or other provider keys. However, setup goes through a device-code login at omnirush.ai/console, and the default models come from your hosted account catalog, so the service side appears to stay vendor-hosted. Missing for 10: documented self-hosting of the backend or account service, the ability to run without omnirush.ai login, a license or self-hosting guide, and independent corroboration.
